title: Rust workspace analysis
subtitle: cargo judge on its own source tree · 1 crate, 54 authored files

data.title: About this report
data.content: The numbers are taken from the sample output in the judge repository (summary, health and map reports of judge run on itself), shortened by hand. judge does not write PDFs; this request was assembled from that output.

data.title: Where the complexity is
data.subtitle: Production code, total cyclomatic complexity per file. Measured, not a verdict.

data.title: Top 8 files by total cyclomatic complexity
duplicate-code: 635 findings in repeated token spans
data.description: The largest clone family has 5 members of 27 tokens in one file, the pattern heuristic builders in src/rules/principle.rs. A second has 3 members of 95 tokens across 3 files (attrs_have_cfg_test).
data.recommendation: Run cargo judge dupes for the families, grouped and prioritised. The ranking is an inspection list, not an instruction to merge.

data.title: panic-in-lib: 22 locations
data.description: Panicking calls in library code, for example Finding::at_span in src/finding.rs:422 and FindingGraph::into_findings in src/finding.rs:973 to 976.
data.recommendation: Return an error, or document the invariant that makes the panic unreachable.

data.title: swallowed-result: write_cache ignores two results
data.description: Two results are discarded in src/rules/slopsquat.rs, lines 356 and 359, both in write_cache.
data.recommendation: Handle the error or state why a failed cache write is harmless.

data.title: suppression-debt: 11 lint suppressions
data.description: All 11 silence clippy::too_many_arguments, 8 of them in src/rules/dead_code.rs.
data.recommendation: Bundle the arguments in a struct where the same group travels together.
